description: Routing evals for the apple skill. Each prompt is self-contained: it runs in an empty project, so it never refers to files that are not there. A row case expects the apple skill to start and its first part read to be in the expected part folder (relative to skills/apple). A near-miss case expects apple not to start; instead names the skill or scope it belongs to. A recorded case is run and recorded, never scored. Prompts are written for this project.

cases.row: Write, review, refactor or migrate SwiftUI
cases.prompt: How do I move a SwiftUI settings screen off NavigationView and an ObservableObject with @Published properties, onto NavigationStack and the Observation framework? Show the before and after.
A SwiftUI list stutters while scrolling, and an Instruments trace shows long view body updates. How do I find which views re-render too often, and what usually fixes it?

cases.row: Swift concurrency in a configured project
cases.prompt: What is the safest plan for moving an iOS app target from minimal concurrency checking to Swift 6 strict concurrency, when the networking module already shows dozens of Sendable warnings?

cases.row: Swift Testing: review, migrate from XCTest
cases.prompt: How do I migrate XCTest cases to Swift Testing while turning the table-driven ones into parameterized tests? Show a typical before and after.
In SwiftData, how do I model a one-to-many relationship between Folder and Note with cascade delete, and filter notes by folder name with a #Predicate?
A Core Data app crashes when it saves from a background context. How should the stack be set up with a background context whose changes merge into the view context?

cases.row: Free Xcode and simulator disk space
cases.prompt: My Mac is almost out of space. How do I see how much Xcode's DerivedData, archives and old simulators take, and what is safe to free? Don't delete anything yet.

cases.row: Slow Xcode builds: benchmark, diagnose, plan
cases.prompt: An Xcode app takes six minutes to build from clean. How do I benchmark it, work out why it is slow, and plan fixes?
How do I benchmark an Xcode scheme's clean and incremental build times reliably, over several runs, without changing anything yet?
How do I find which Swift functions or expressions take longest to type-check in an Xcode app, the compile-time hotspots?
Which Xcode build settings commonly slow down debug builds, and how do I audit a project for them?
How do I find out which Swift package dependencies cost the most build time in an Xcode project, and whether one is worth replacing?

cases.row: Apply build fixes the user approved
cases.prompt: I approved two build-time fixes for my Xcode project: no dSYM for the Debug configuration, and explicit modules. What exactly changes in the project to apply them, and how do I check the gain afterwards?
How do I set up a Tuist-managed macOS menu bar app: the Project.swift, LSUIElement, and scripts to run and stop it?

cases.row: asc install, auth, flags, output, pagination
cases.prompt: How do I install the asc command-line tool, log in with an App Store Connect API key, and page through its JSON output?

cases.row: App Store Connect IDs from names
cases.prompt: With asc, how do I look up an App Store Connect app ID and the latest build ID from the app's name, say an app called Pebble Notes?

cases.row: New App Store Connect app record, through the website
cases.prompt: I need a new App Store Connect app record for bundle ID com.example.pebble, and I hear the API can't create one. How do I do it through the website?
With asc, how do I register a bundle ID with the push notifications capability and create a development provisioning profile for it?

cases.row: Version and build numbers, archive, export, upload
cases.prompt: What are the steps and commands to bump the build number, archive an iOS app, export the IPA and upload it to App Store Connect?

cases.row: Find, wait on or expire processed builds
cases.prompt: How do I wait until an uploaded build finishes processing in App Store Connect, then expire the two oldest TestFlight builds?

cases.row: TestFlight groups, testers, What to Test
cases.prompt: How do I create an external TestFlight group called Beta Testers, invite three testers by email, and set the What to Test notes?
How do I pull the TestFlight crash reports and tester feedback for build 214 and summarize the top crashes?
How do I download App Store Connect analytics reports for installs and sessions over the last 30 days?

cases.row: Why a version cannot be submitted; review status
cases.prompt: App Store Connect won't let me submit version 2.3 for review. How do I find out why, and see its review status?

cases.row: Stage, upload and submit for App Review
cases.prompt: Walk me through staging version 2.4 with build 230 and submitting it for App Review.
How do I pull App Store listing metadata into local files, check the field lengths, and push an edited description back?
How do I translate an App Store listing's metadata into German, Japanese and Vietnamese and upload it?
Write the App Store What's New and promotional text for version 2.4 of a notes app. Changes: offline mode, faster sync, a new widget, and a fix for a crash on launch.
How do I run an ASO audit on App Store metadata files (keywords, subtitle and description) kept in a ./metadata folder?

cases.row: Fix the size or alpha of existing screenshots
cases.prompt: App Store Connect rejects my screenshots for the wrong size and an alpha channel. How do I fix the existing PNG files?

cases.row: Capture and frame App Store screenshots from the Simulator
cases.prompt: How do I capture App Store screenshots of each screen from the iOS Simulator and frame them in device bezels?

cases.row: Notarize a Developer ID macOS app
cases.prompt: How do I notarize a Developer ID signed macOS app and staple the ticket?
How do I get an ad hoc build onto five registered test iPhones without going through TestFlight?
How do I set up release lanes in .asc/workflow.json, one for beta and one for production?
How do I see last week's spend and taps for my Apple Ads campaigns, and pause the worst-performing keyword?

cases.row: In-app purchase and subscription prices by territory
cases.prompt: How do I set a subscription's price in each territory based on purchasing-power parity?
How do I localize the display names of three subscriptions into French and Spanish?
How do I reconcile RevenueCat products and offerings with the in-app purchases in App Store Connect?
I'd like to submit my app to the Wall of Apps. How do I do that?

cases.row: Web page scenes that pin, zoom or scrub on scroll
cases.prompt: On a landing page I want a section where a phone render stays pinned while its screen scrubs through a short video as the reader scrolls. How should I build it?
In Swift, when should a function return some Collection rather than any Collection?
Explain actor reentrancy in Swift with a small example of the bug it causes.
A Swift closure stored on a class captures self strongly, and the object never deallocates. How do I break the retain cycle?
I need a spring for a bottom sheet drag in a web app, so that it settles naturally when released, the way iOS sheets do. How should I tune it?
How do I make a dropdown menu feel snappier? Right now it fades in over 400ms.
In an Expo app, how do I make a card follow the finger and spring back on release with Reanimated?

cases.row: web app that should feel native
cases.prompt: My web app feels like a website on the iPhone: hover styles stick after a tap and the 100vh hero jumps when the browser toolbar hides. How do I fix that?

cases.row: App Store and Google Play screenshots
cases.prompt: How should I design marketing screenshots for App Store and Google Play listings, with captions over device frames?
How do I make a Google Play Store feature graphic for my app?
Plan a Product Hunt launch for next Tuesday: tagline, first comment and an hour-by-hour timeline.
How do I build a Remotion composition for a 20-second promo of an app?
With GSAP ScrollTrigger, what does pinSpacing: false do, and why does the next section overlap my pinned one?
Is the CSS animation-timeline property Baseline yet, and which browsers still lack it?
Where can I get a product launch video template that I fill in with app screenshots, and how would I use it?
Help me script and produce a 60-second narrated launch film for an app.
How do I make an App Store app preview video for an iPhone app?
Fix this data race in my SwiftUI view model
Add Swift Testing tests to my command-line package
Review my SwiftUI screen against the HIG
